basic_profile.bio: A curious soul from Albany, New York, exploring the cosmic mysteries of the universe. I'm a 22-year-old college student studying psychology at UAlbany, with a budding interest in alternative spirituality and the metaphysical. I often find myself questioning the status quo, seeking deeper meanings behind everyday experiences. Although new to Reddit, I love engaging in thought-provoking discussions about the nature of reality and human consciousness. My evenings are usually spent diving into esoteric readings or attending local community meetups. I'm currently single, and when not studying, I enjoy participating in local art events and trying out new recipes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from a mix of formal education in psychology and self-directed exploration of spiritual and metaphysical topics. I often browse through books and online resources that delve into existential psychology and alternative spiritual practices.
